input.prompt:
You are the **boss agent** building PoC #2 of "Maple Boss" (MapleStory party-boss helper, Korean server KMS). Project root: /Users/jyl/work/repo/ai-agent-live/maple-boss. Read first: `docs/POC_PLAN.md` (ownership, data facts, dev-server rule), `docs/MAPLE_BOSS_CONTEXT.md` (user spec), `pocs/lib/types.ts` (the `Boss` type — don't change it), `pocs/lib/db.ts`, and `.claude/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` (follow it: smallest code that works).

## Goal
Input a boss name (Korean, e.g. "카링", "검은 마법사", partial match OK) → show boss image(s) per difficulty and stats (level, HP, defense rate %, force type + required force, max party size, statBasis 300/380, cut).

## What you own (edit nothing else)
- `pocs/boss/` — seed data + logic + public interface in `pocs/boss/index.ts` (`listBosses()`, `getBoss(id)` — replace stub bodies, keep signatures; the party agent depends on them). Storing the seed as a typed TS array is fine; also mirror into a SQLite `bosses` table only if it's simpler for search — your call (ponytail: prefer the simpler one).
- `pocs/public/bosses/` — downloaded boss images.
- `pocs/app/boss/` (page) and `pocs/app/api/boss/` (API: `GET /api/boss?q=` search, `GET /api/boss/<id>` optional).

## Data
- Cover the current KMS weekly/monthly party-boss lineup with difficulties, at minimum: 스우, 데미안, 가디언 엔젤 슬라임, 루시드, 윌, 더스크, 진 힐라, 듄켈, 검은 마법사, 선택받은 세렌, 감시자 칼로스, 최초의 대적자, 카링, 찬란한 흉성, 림보, 발드릭스 (plus their Normal/Hard/Chaos/Extreme variants that exist). `id` = `${difficulty}-${slug}` (e.g. `normal-kaling`, `extreme-black-mage`).
- Stats: research from public sources (MapleStory wiki/namu wiki/official KMS pages) via web fetch. Where you're unsure, still fill a best estimate and record it in a short `pocs/boss/SOURCES.md` (which values are verified vs estimated, with URLs). Don't invent precision you don't have — mark it.
- `statBasis`: "380" for bosses with defense ≥ 380%, else "300".
- `cut` (환산 주스탯 needed for a solo clear within time limit): real values come later from maplescouter's `calculatedData.bossCuts` (the orchestrator captures them in a live HIL crawl). For now put monotonic estimates that make sense across difficulty (e.g. low tens of thousands for 노말 스우-tier up to ~200,000+ for top extreme bosses) and mark all of them `estimate` in SOURCES.md. Keep cut values in one obvious place so they're easy to replace.
- Images: download locally into `pocs/public/bosses/<slug>.png` (imageUrl `/bosses/<slug>.png`). One image per boss (shared across difficulties) is fine. Candidate source: maplestory.io mob render API (e.g. `https://maplestory.io/api/KMS/<version>/mob/<mobId>/render/stand`) — verify it works; or another public source. Do not hotlink. If an image can't be found, use a neutral placeholder and list it in SOURCES.md. maplescouter.com itself is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile check — don't try to bypass it.

## Page `/boss`
Search input (with a datalist/autocomplete of boss names), results grouped by boss with each difficulty as a row/card: image, 난이도 badge, Lv, HP (Korean units like 1조 2000억), 방어율, 포스(아케인/어센틱 N), 최대 인원, 기준(방어율 300/380), 컷(환산). Plain Tailwind, dark neutral surface, Korean UI copy; **no design flourishes** — a hallmark design pass happens later.

## Rules
- A shared `next dev` is already running at http://localhost:3000 — **never start another `next dev`/`next build` in `pocs/`**. Verify with `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint <your files>`, and `curl localhost:3000/api/boss?q=카링` etc.
- Don't touch `pocs/character`, `pocs/party`, `pocs/crawler`, `pocs/lib/*`, `pocs/app/page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`. If the shared contract should change, say so in your report.

## Report back (concise)
Boss count and difficulty variants covered; which stats are verified vs estimated; image coverage (how many real vs placeholder); check outputs (tsc/eslint/curl key lines); open questions.

input.prompt:
You are the **character agent** building PoC #1 of "Maple Boss" (MapleStory party-boss helper). Project root: /Users/jyl/work/repo/ai-agent-live/maple-boss. Read first: `docs/POC_PLAN.md` (ownership, data facts, policy, dev-server rule), `docs/MAPLE_BOSS_CONTEXT.md` (user spec), `pocs/lib/types.ts` (the `Character` type — don't change it), `pocs/lib/db.ts`, and `.claude/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` (follow it: smallest code that works, test only risky logic).

## Goal
Input a character nickname → register it → show the character sprite and stats (level, job, world, 전투력, 보스300 환산, 보스380 환산). Data comes from crawling maplescouter.com with **Scrapling** (https://github.com/d4vinci/Scrapling, v0.5.1 verified installable via `uv pip install "scrapling[fetchers]"`; note `DynamicFetcher` is NOT exported from `scrapling.fetchers` in 0.5.1 — inspect the installed package to find the right browser fetcher API, and run `scrapling install` / playwright browser install if needed).

## What you own (edit nothing else)
- `pocs/crawler/` — Python crawler. Use a uv venv at `pocs/crawler/.venv` (gitignored).
- `pocs/character/` — logic, SQLite table (own `characters` table, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, via `db` from `@/lib/db`), and the public interface in `pocs/character/index.ts` (`listCharacters()`, `getCharacter(name)` — replace the stub bodies, keep signatures; the party agent depends on them).
- `pocs/app/character/` (page) and `pocs/app/api/character/` (API).

## Crawler design (mandatory constraints)
- Target: `https://maplescouter.com/ko/result?name=<urlencoded name>`. The site is protected by a Cloudflare **Turnstile human check**. **Do NOT enable any automatic CAPTCHA/Turnstile solving** (no `solve_cloudflare=True` or equivalents, no third-party solvers). The design is human-in-the-loop: open a **visible (headful) browser** with a **persistent profile dir** `pocs/crawler/.profile` (gitignored) so a human clicks the check once and clearance persists ~10 minutes. If the check dialog ("사람 확인이 필요해요") is visible, write `HIL: 브라우저 창에서 '사람인지 확인' 체크박스를 눌러주세요` to stderr and keep polling (timeout ~180s).
- After load, read `localStorage['character-store']` → `state.searchResult`. The store initially holds a **placeholder** (character_name `으낭다`, character_image `/images/monster.png`) — wait until `userApiData.info.character_name` matches the requested name (or the page shows a not-found message → exit code 2).
- Output: print one JSON object to stdout: `{ "character": <Character fields>, "raw": <state.searchResult> }`. Field mapping: name/world/job/level/image from `userApiData.info` (`character_name, world_name, character_class, character_level, character_image` — make image absolute if relative), combatPower/boss300Stat/boss380Stat from `calculatedData` (`combatPower, boss300_stat, boss380_stat`).
- Also write the raw payload to `docs/research/samples/<name>.json` (the boss/party work needs real `calculatedData.bossCuts`).
- Provide a `--from-file <path>` mode that skips the browser and parses a saved payload — use it to test the parser against `docs/research/character-store.json` (placeholder schema). **Do not run the live headful crawl yourself** — the orchestrator runs it with the human operator. You may do one quick check that the browser launches headful and navigates, then close it, only if it doesn't hang; otherwise skip.
- Keep the Python small (one file is fine).

## Next.js side
- `POST /api/character {name}`: return cached row if fetched < 1h ago; else spawn the crawler (`pocs/crawler/.venv/bin/python pocs/crawler/<script>.py <name>`, use `child_process.execFile`, generous timeout ~200s), upsert into SQLite, return the Character. Clear error JSON on failure (exit 2 = not found, timeout = "HIL 확인 필요/시간초과").
- `GET /api/character`: list registered characters.
- Seed fixtures so the UI and party PoC work without a live crawl: an idempotent seed of ~6 obviously-labelled sample characters with `source: "fixture"` and varied plausible stats (boss300Stat between ~30,000 and ~130,000; imageUrl may be empty → UI shows a placeholder). Expose seeding via `POST /api/character/seed` (and/or auto-seed when the table is empty — your call, keep it simple).
- `/character` page: name input + 등록 button, loading state that tells the user a browser window may open for the human check, result card (sprite, level/job/world, 전투력 formatted Korean-style e.g. 8억 5646만, 보스300/380 환산 with thousands separators), and a list of registered characters. Plain Tailwind, dark neutral surface, Korean UI copy; **no design flourishes** — a hallmark design pass happens later.
- Use `export const runtime = "nodejs"` on API routes. Server-only DB access.

## Rules

<result>The boss PoC is in place: 16 bosses in 44 difficulty variants, a `/boss` search page and the API. tsc, eslint and the new unit tests pass, and the curl checks return the expected data. Every cut value is still an estimate, and the boss stats come from the GMS-oriented English wiki, not a Korean source.

**Coverage**
- 스우: 노말, 하드, 익스트림 (익스트림 is 2인)
- 데미안: 노말, 하드
- 가디언 엔젤 슬라임: 노말, 카오스
- 루시드, 윌: 이지, 노말, 하드
- 더스크: 노말, 카오스
- 진 힐라, 듄켈: 노말, 하드
- 검은 마법사: 하드, 익스트림
- 선택받은 세렌: 노말, 하드, 익스트림
- 감시자 칼로스: 이지, 노말, 카오스, 익스트림
- 최초의 대적자 (3인): 이지, 노말, 하드, 익스트림
- 카링: 이지, 노말, 하드, 익스트림
- 찬란한 흉성 (3인): 노말, 하드
- 림보, 발드릭스 (3인): 노말, 하드, 익스트림

Ids follow the `${difficulty}-${slug}` pattern, e.g. `normal-kaling`, `extreme-black-mage`. 듄켈 is `darknell`, 찬란한 흉성 is `malefic-star`.

**Where the stats come from**
- **Sourced:** level, HP, 방어율, force and max party come from maplestorywiki.net monster tables. Namu wiki returned 403 to automated fetches.
- **Not checked against KMS:** that wiki is GMS-oriented, and HP can differ by region. The one KMS cross-check I did (카링 Lv 285, 방어율 380, from the maplestory.io KMS data) matched.
- **HP:** I added up one HP bar per phase. Phases with several mobs count once.
- **Multi-phase bosses:** level, 방어율 and force use the highest phase. So 칼로스 이지/노말 count as 380 (330 in phase 1, 380 in phase 2), and 세렌 counts as 어센틱 200.
- **Unverified rows:** the KMS-only 익스트림 림보/발드릭스. Also 진 힐라's max party: 6 is an assumption because its wiki infobox didn't parse.
- **statBasis:** set from 방어율 (380 or above gives "380").
- **Cuts:** all 44 are estimates, roughly 10,000 × (HP ÷ 노말 스우 HP)^0.3. They run from about 9,000 to 255,000 and always rise with difficulty within a boss. They sit in one `CUTS` table at the top of `pocs/boss/data.ts`, ready to swap for maplescouter's `bossCuts`. The page marks each cut "(추정)".

**Images:** 16 real images, no placeholders. They were downloaded once from the wiki's image host into `pocs/public/bosses/<slug>.png` (3.2MB total), not hotlinked. maplestory.io works for most bosses, but it returns animated GIFs, some come back blank (윌, 더스크), and its latest KMS version has no 최초의 대적자, 찬란한 흉성 or 발드릭스.

**What I built**
- `listBosses()` and `getBoss()` now return real data with the signatures unchanged. I added `findBosses(q)`.
- Search ignores spaces and requires every word to match difficulty, name or id. "카링 노말" works, and so does "익스트림 검은마법사".
